notes.title: Version 1.01 Update!
notes.content:
Ninja Smasher! was updated to Version 1.01!

Crash bugs have also been fixed!

The update contents will be as follows!

· Bug fixes
· Modify graphics
· When hook chain sickle on a wall or ceiling, reuse chain sickle without special item
· Add enlarged map display
